annotations.title: Replace or animate a character using video and a reference image

description:
Use only with the user's own likeness or content they are authorized to use. Do not use for impersonation, deception, sexual content, or content involving minors.

MCP guidance:
- Starts an async video job; returns `id` and `credits_charged`. For finished results, call `wait_for_video_project` with that id or poll `GET /v1/video-projects/{id}` until `complete`, `error`, or `canceled`. Results include `downloads`; wait helpers add `exact_download_urls`. Preserve signed URLs and query parameters; never append expiration metadata.
- For `*_file_path`, use an existing Magic Hour path or the upload-URL endpoint's `file_path` after uploading raw bytes to its presigned URL. Direct public media URLs may work if stable and fetchable as raw bytes; hotlinked URLs can fail. Prefer the upload-URL endpoint when unsure.

Replace a video subject or transfer video motion onto a reference character image. Requires `assets.video_file_path`, `assets.image_file_path` and `end_seconds`. Model support controls duration, resolution and subject selection; see parameter schemas. Generation consumes credits; the queued video charge is an estimate, with the final charge available on the completed project.

assets.description: Source video and reference character image for the job.

image_file_path.description:
Reference character image used as the replacement or animation target. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

video_file_path.description:
Source video containing the subject to replace or animate. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

end_seconds.description: End time of your clip (seconds). Must be greater than start_seconds.

model.description:
Model to use. Defaults to `wan-animate`.

* **`wan-animate`**: 480p, 720p. Supports `points` subject selection.
* **`kling-3.0`**: 720p, 1080p. Clips of 3–10 seconds in `replace` mode or 3–30 seconds in `animate` mode. Picks the main person automatically, so `points` are rejected.
* **`minimax-h3`**: 480p, 720p, 1080p. Clips of 1–60 seconds in `replace` mode or 1–60 seconds in `animate` mode. Subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored.

name.description: Give your video a custom name for easy identification.

resolution.description: Output video resolution. Must be supported by `model`. Defaults to the lowest resolution available on your plan for that model.

start_seconds.description: Start time of your clip (seconds). Must be ≥ 0.

style.description: Optional style controls for replace vs animate mode and subject selection.

mode.description: Processing mode. `replace` swaps the detected subject with your reference character. `animate` transfers motion from the video onto your character image.

points.description: On-frame markers for manual subject selection. Required when `selection_mode` is `point`. Ignored when `selection_mode` is `auto` or omitted. Rejected for models without subject selection (supported by `wan-animate`, `minimax-h3`). `minimax-h3` subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored.

position_x.description: Horizontal pixel coordinate in the source video frame at `time_seconds`, measured from the left edge.

position_y.description: Vertical pixel coordinate in the source video frame at `time_seconds`, measured from the top edge.

time_seconds.description: Timestamp on the source video timeline in seconds. Uses the same clock as `start_seconds` and `end_seconds`.

prompt.description: Optional direction. Supported by kling-3.0, minimax-h3.

selection_mode.description: How to locate the subject in the source video. `auto` detects a person automatically. `point` uses your `points` to mark the subject and is supported by `wan-animate`, `minimax-h3`. `minimax-h3` subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored. Defaults to `auto`.

name: character_replace_create_video

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the video. If the status is not 'complete', this value is an estimate and may be adjusted upon completion based on the actual FPS of the output video. 

If video generation fails, credits will be refunded, and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the video. Use it with the [Get video Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/video-projects/get-video-details) to fetch status and downloads.
